description: This file defines API routes for recipe-related endpoints using FastAPI, including listing recipes with filters and retrieving recipe details by ID. It interacts with an SQLAlchemy ORM model and converts model instances to schema objects for API responses.

classes.name: RecipeOut
classes.description: Schema representing the output format of recipe data sent in API responses.

methods.name: RecipeOut _model_to_schema(r: Recipe)
methods.description: Converts a Recipe ORM model instance into a RecipeOut schema object for API responses.

methods.description: Async handler for GET /recipes; returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of recipes.

methods.description: Async handler for GET /recipes/{id}; returns detailed information for a specific recipe by ID.
